roles.title: Building across web and mobile
roles.description: Joined GeekyAnts building and shipping features across web and mobile client engagements with Next.js and React Native. Worked closely with design and backend teams to take work from spec to production, taking on increasingly complex parts of each codebase as ownership grew.

roles.title: Owning technical scope
roles.description: Promoted to Software Engineer III after two years. Now own larger technical scope on client engagements - architecture and implementation decisions, code review, and coordination across web and mobile workstreams - while mentoring newer engineers joining the team.
